structure: Idaho Content Standards K-12 Social Studies (rev. 11/2025). Front matter: cover, preamble/committee, contents, introduction, organization. K-5: one section per grade (Kindergarten, Grade 1-5), each with five strand headings (History, Geography, Economics, Civics and Government, Global Perspectives), each strand with a 'Students will...' description and a Code/Standard table; codes G.SS.s.n (e.g. K.SS.1.1, 5.SS.4.13; strand number 1-5). Grades 6-9: World Geography and World History and Civilizations courses, codes 6-9.WG.s.n and 6-9.WH.s.n, strands 1-5 plus skills strand 6 (Geography Skills / Historical Thinking Skills). High school/middle: United States History I (6-12.US1.n, sequential numbering by time period headings), United States History II (9-12.US2.n), shared Historical Thinking Skills (6-12.HT1.n after US I, 6-12.HT2.n after US II), American Government (9-12.GOV.n), Economics (9-12.EC.n), and an optional Foundations of Western Civilization course (9-12.WC.n) preceded by a context letter. Bulleted lists (e.g. events, people) sit inside the standard cell and are labeled with it. No separate examples sections; every table is 'Code | Standard' (cells C1 code, C4 standard text). Closing contact line.

issues: u582: heading 'World Geography and Civilizations Grades 6-9' covers two courses (World Geography, World History and Civilizations); given grades 6-9, course null.
Grades 6-9 courses (WG, WH) span middle-school and 9th grade; labeled grades '6-9' (cluster rows 6-8 and 9-12 both apply), course titles as headings.
u798-u967: US History I codes are 6-12.US1.n so grades 6-12 (not 9-12); US History II is 9-12.US2.n.
